gap: The two round-4 defects are genuinely fixed and both verify clean: h1 is 88px/98.56px (ratio 1.120) with rendered line-top deltas of 98.5 and 99.0 CSS px, headline-to-lede ink gap measures 46.0 CSS px (h1 margin-bottom 44px), Source Serif 4 really renders (canvas width 1029.45px, distinct from Georgia 1150.45, Times/Cambria 1053.38, Playfair 1144.26, Didot 1162.13, Bodoni 976.98) with font-variation-settings 'opsz' 24 on h1 and every h2/h3, so no hairline display master, and headline plus body share one ink rgb(13,27,94) at 14.41:1 on the cream ground, worst body sample on the page 6.15:1, all past AA. But fixing the defects only bought parity, not a win. Ground (#f9f4f1 vs the bar's #faf3ef, bands #9aa8f5 and #cfe0fb), ink (#0d1b5e), accent (#1650ee), and the CTA pill (999px, solid, white label, zero shadow, zero border, zero gradient) are the bar's own values, so matching there cannot beat it. Flatness is clean (0 gradients, 0 background-clip:text, 8 box-shadows total, all diffuse and confined to the nav dropdown, hero window and float-card callouts, which the bar also uses). The loss is on the one axis where we chose independently: display leading over-corrected past the bar and out the other side. Measured from the bar's own pixels, its h1 line tops sit 74.5 CSS px apart on a face whose ascender-to-baseline ink band is 52.0px (roughly a 78px face at ratio 0.95); ours sits 98.5px apart on 88px at 1.12. At nearly the same display size the bar packs its lines 24 CSS px tighter, which is what makes 'Clear books. Confident decisions.' read as one sculpted block while 'The ERP / that speaks / your language.' reads as three separate lines floating apart. Compounding it, our face is set at weight 500 with opsz 24, so at 1500px zoom it shows sturdy stems, low stroke contrast and chunky bracketed wedge serifs, reading bookish and heavy next to the bar's lighter, higher-modulation transitional. We fled the hairline didone and landed on chunky-and-airy. To win: pull display line-height to about 0.95-1.00 (roughly 84-88px on the 88px h1), drop the display weight from 500 toward 400-450, and keep the 44-46px headline-to-lede gap as it is, since the bar's own equivalent is 49.5px and ours is already correct there. Minor accent drift worth noting but not decisive: the violet #6d28d9 is promoted to a full-bleed CTA ground the bar never uses, and the pill on that band inverts to white, so the loudest CTA on the page is the one place the accent hue is absent.
